title: Kusanagi Nene — Lessons Learnt Alone〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream

rows.Line: Nene's Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Today's practice was more exhausting than usual for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it was also really good since we got so much done...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I think we have Tsukasa to thank for that...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“I do not know.
I am no swordsman, nor do I possess the strength to break stone.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “At the same time, how long has this feeling lingered within me...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “This inexplicable compulsion to protect the world. It feels as though it has been branded into my soul...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (After just a few days of attending that workshop, Tsukasa learned how to act in such a convincing manner...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, he sort of had to learn acting all on his own up to this point.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And yet, despite never being part of a theatre group or learning from experienced actors before, he's able to put on these incredible performances playing the lead role.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He improved so much after working with Asahi too. If he receives formal training on top of that...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, there's still the possibility that the director running Tsukasa's workshop is just really good at what they do...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A workshop, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It reminds me of how much fun I had with my theatre group when I was little. It's like I got to make a new discovery each time I went...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Then, I got to be the lead...and...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, I'm not scared of going on stage anymore. I have the others behind me.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But is that because I know they're performing alongside me...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (What happens when I have to go on stage with people I don't know...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yikes... I'm already sort of afraid of meeting a bunch of new people all at once... I feel like I'd freeze up or something...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
But it's not like I'm completely uninterested in attending one of those workshops.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe I should practice introducing myself a bit...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Something normal...
Nothing like the weird one Tsukasa did.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My name is Nene Kusanagi. I'm looking forward to working with you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I should probably say, “It's nice to meet you,” somewhere... Also, where I work and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My name is Nene Kusanagi. It's nice to meet you. I perform in shows at Phoenix Wonderland as a member of the cast.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Uh oh...
What do I say after that part...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... My hobbies, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I tried looking online for some good ways to introduce myself, but I don't think any of them will work for me...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can probably talk about the shows I've seen and done just fine... But those workshops usually involve having discussions...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Plus, doing a show with a big group isn't just about acting. You have to talk and get to know each other...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Having to meet new people to do shows with them is probably the worst part of theatre for me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But Tsukasa's working really hard, so I should...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I know...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Found it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
The notebook I kept when I was still with my old theatre group was right where I left it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Most of what I wrote is pretty fundamental, but I might be able to learn something new by going back through it...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'll start by reviewing everything in here...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's begin...!
